The '''Assimilators''' were powerful [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] warriors created by the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanians]].<ref name="egtd" />

==Characteristics==
Ruthless and aggressive, Assimilators were made of specialized bio-components and were essentially a jumble of organics and circuitry, though were fully sentient and possessed personalities.<ref name="egtd" /> Key to their construction was the ability to self-repair, rebuild damaged parts, and assimilate mechanical and organic parts into themselves; an Assimilator could theoretically live for centuries by simply replacing its own components, with even the brain being interchangeable.<ref name="egtd" /><ref name="SWFF116" />

It was exceptionally hard to permanently kill an Assimilator; Assimilators could repair themselves from even the most egregious injuries, and so long as any sizable component was left behind they could reconstitute themselves - though this could take time.<ref name="egtd" /><ref name="SWFF116" /> Because of this, it was said that the only sure way to kill an Assimilator was to atomize it into its base constituents.<ref name="egtd" />

==History==
Created by the [[Arkanian Renegades]] as part of their effort to overthrow the [[Politics/Legends|government]] of [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]], the [[Arkanian Dominion]], the Assimilators were created as living weapons and powerful foot soldiers.<ref name="egtd" /><ref name="SWFF116" /> In retaliation, the [[techno-lord]]s of the Dominion created [[Accelerated Transgenic Heuristic Abhorer]]s.<ref name="swcw" /> After the Arkanian Dominion and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] jointly crushed the Renegades, many of their creations escaped into the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="egtd" />

The most famous Assimilator was [[Gorm (cyborg)|Gorm the Dissolver]] who would pursue a career as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], survive multiple encounters with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and repair himself after being shot in the back of the head by a lucky [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]].<ref name="egtd" /><ref name="Greedo">''{{DB|character|greedo|Greedo}}''</ref>
